concepts.description: A modular unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated robotic platform that interacts with the environment through sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system interact, specifying values and events.
A component within the AUV module that manages and directs the behavior of the AUV system.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module to represent fundamental value categories.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module that groups multiple related values together.
A data element contained within an interface, representing a specific piece of information available through that interface.
An occurrence or signal defined within an interface that can be triggered or received by components of the AUV system.
An input argument passed to an event or function within the AUV module.
A named operation defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a computed output.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
The interface providing sensor data to the AUV platform.
The interface providing actuator commands to the AUV platform.
The controller responsible for operator-level control of the AUV, using the Inputs interface.
The interface providing input commands to the AUV_Operator controller.
The Last Response Engine controller, using both the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
The interface providing output commands from the LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot controllers.
The autopilot controller of the AUV, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the radial component, of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the polar component, of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the azimuth component, of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the north-south relative distance, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the east-west relative distance, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the depth of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the identifier of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the heading of the obstacle, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing the heading of the AUV, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing an obstacle detected by the AUV, of type Obstacle.
An interface defining input events for the AUV module, including endTask, reqOCM, reqMOM, reqHCM, reqVel, and reqHdng.
An event in the Intpus interface signalling the end of a task, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting an OCM mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting a MOM mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting an HCM mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting a velocity value, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting a heading value, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Outputs interface advising a velocity value, taking one parameter of type real and no return value.
An event in the Outputs interface advising a heading value, taking one parameter of type real and no return value.
A composite type recording values for horiz_cda, vert_cda, and id related to close-distance data.
A field of the Close composite type representing the horizontal close distance approach, of type real.
A field of the Close composite type representing the vertical close distance approach, of type real.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
